propositions: The pip-audit gating job fails on every patchset against main due to PYSEC-2026-2132 (command injection in click.edit), blocking all Verified +1 votes.
click 8.2.1 is pinned in uv.lock as a transitive dependency via inspect-ai, which caps click below 8.2.2 with the constraint click!=8.2.0,<8.2.2,>=8.1.3.
The vulnerable click.edit() code path is unreachable in rebar because rebar never imports click directly and does not call click.edit().
uv constraint-dependencies cannot lift the inspect-ai cap; override-dependencies must be used to replace the requirement and permit click >= 8.3.3.
The cap is stale: inspect-ai 0.3.251 imports cleanly and runs its CLI under click 8.4.2, proving no real incompatibility exists.

The fix uses [tool.uv] override-dependencies = ["click>=8.3.3"] in pyproject.toml to upgrade click to 8.4.2 in this repo's lock, with a REMOVE-WHEN condition tied to upstream PR UKGovernmentBEIS/inspect_ai#4596.
